title: Lab - Modifying CPU resources with the VPA
description: Let the VPA recommend and apply CPU changes.
scenario: Let the VPA recommend and apply CPU changes. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Create a VPA
tasks.instructions: Create a VPA for Deployment hamster in Off mode and read its recommendation.
tasks.verification: kubectl describe vpa hamster | grep -A5 Recommendation

tasks.title: Task 2 - Auto mode
tasks.instructions: Switch the update mode to Auto and watch Pods get recreated with new requests.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Limits
tasks.instructions: Bound the recommendation with minAllowed and maxAllowed.
